snippet.title: DIGGER | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Digg. Or Die. DIGGER. Only in theaters October 2. #Diggermovie



Academy Award winner Tom Cruise stars in Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s original film “Digger,” from Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures.
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.
Cruise stars in the title role, alongside Oscar winner Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Oscar nominee Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Oscar nominee Jesse Plemons.  Robert John Burke, Emma D’Arcy, Burn Gorman and Sophie Wilde also star. 
Iñárritu directed from a screenplay by Iñárritu & Oscar-winners Alexander Dinelaris & Nicolás Giacobone, and Sabina Berman, story by Iñárritu & Berman.  The film is produced by Iñárritu, Oscar nominee Mary Parent, Cruise and Michael Sharp, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Berman, Dinelaris, Giacobone, Jez Butterworth and Emmanuel Lubezki.
Joining Iñárritu behind the camera are previous collaborators Oscar-winning director of photography Emmanuel Lubezki; editors Conor O’Neill and Oscar winner Stephen Mirrone; Oscar-nominated costume designer Jacqueline West; Oscar-winning makeup and hair designer Alessandro Bertolazzi; and Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler; along with Oscar-winning production designer Dennis Gassner and production designer Richard Johnson, Oscar-winning prosthetic makeup designer Kazu Hiro, and composer Cosmo Sheldrake.
An Alejandro G. Iñárritu Film, “Digger” was shot entirely in VistaVision and will be released in theaters and IMAX® across North America on October 2, 2026, and internationally beginning 30 September 2026.  It will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

snippet.title: Ramayana - Varanasi Theme | Telugu Trailer | Mahesh Babu | Jr NTR | Rajamouli (Fan-Made)
snippet.description:
ధర్మో రక్షతి రక్షితః - Dharma protects those who protect Dharma.

When you stand for Dharma — birds, squirrels, vanaras, oceans… the entire creation stands with you.

That is what happens when one man chooses what is right over what is easy.


He gave up a kingdom — not because he had to, but because it was right.
She carried his name in every breath — even when the world forgot hers.
He slept on cold stone — so his brother's sandals could sit on the throne.
He burned with devotion — and destroyed himself protecting what he loved.

Four lives. One truth. Dharma above all.

This is not just a story that happened long ago.
This is the story that happens every time someone chooses duty over desire, sacrifice over self, and love over power.

This is not mythology. This is the truth of what it means to be human.

This is Ramayana.

Get ready for the ultimate musical ride with the latest Haryanvi song featuring the queen Sapna Chaudhary, sung by the amazing duo Amanraj Gill & Komal Chaudhary! 🎵✨
जब छोरी ने टोकया छोरे की लाल आख्यां पै, तो सुणो छोरे का कती धकड़ जवाब! 😉 This track brings you a hilarious and relatable banter between two lovers.

Ho bata aise konsi khuraak lewe se 
Chehre pe chamak tere nyari laagti 

Taam jhaam samjh te bahar ke tere 
Tu ibbe saare mattera ne konya jaanti

Hoo top tera naam chaal rya se aajkaal 
Top tera naam chaal rya se aajkaal 

Aag mere naam te bale se darling 

Tu nasha kon kon sa kare se darling 
Kyu aakh teri chadhiae rawe se darling 

Yaariya me yaar me bithayi se tasalli 
Rr aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli 
Rr aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli

Ho kyate kaafile ne lekr aawe jaawe bahar rree
Kadde akele na ekali tu fett yaar ne 
Ho suna tije din thane tehsilla raho soo
Kahi suni baat pe na kare hate yaar ne 

Suna tije din thane tehsilla raho sooo
Ho kahi suni baat pe na kare hate yaar neeee
Ho firu mai to jaan den ne bhi tere peee
Ho tere jaise ghaniye mare se darling 

Tu nasha kon kon sa kare se darling 
Kyu aakh teri chadhi ae rawe se darling 

Ho yaariya me yaar ne bithayi se tasalli 
Re aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli 
Re aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli

RAP:- (AMANRAJ GILL) 
Mai naam gaane me deu
Gaane ka rate badha deu
Baithu jin gailya unki
Uth baith badha deu
Dedu halki smile 
To jale bhott log 
Baat baata ke me chhoriya ka
Weight badha deu
Maama nashe ke me yaar jisa ganda na koi 
Per sofiya me yaar jisa banda na koi 
Issa dhandha na koi 
Jo challa talle lakha ke 
Chitti chhoriya me jabbe charche laal aakhan ke 
Baat baata ke konya chhori kare na anghayi 
Tanne deu aise cheze rawe aakh teri high
Ke kar lenge vaidh 
Ke karle hakeem
Rawe gaal tere laal 
Aise dedunga dawai 

Re tu kaam kyate saare katti wrong kare hh…
Haryana ke gharaana te belong kare se …
Saare badmashi aale kyate song kare hai…
Chhora kadde na satara wale dhong kare seee….
Saare badmashi aale kyate song kare hai…
Chhore kadde na satara aale dhong kare seee…..

Ho manne laagta tu katti shareef na 

Shareef ghane taawli mare se darling 

Tu nasha kon kon sa kare se darling 
Kyu aakh teri chadhi ae rawe se darling 

Yaariya me yaar ne bithayi se tasalli 
Re aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli 
Re aakh bina piya khaya rawe se nasheeli…..

Song: मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan


Lose yourself in the sacred lanes of Vrindavan with this soulful rendition: "Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha." This Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan captures the deep desire of a devotee to become a peacock in the gardens of Nidhivan, just to be close to Radha Rani and Krishna.

मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा - वृंदावन की इस पावन धुन में खो जाएँ। Palak  Bhakti आपके लिए लेकर आया है श्री राधा-कृष्ण की महिमा का एक ऐसा भजन जो आपके हृदय को शांति और आनंद से भर देगा।

यह मधुर और भावपूर्ण Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan ब्रज की पावन भावना और राधा-कृष्ण के दिव्य प्रेम को समर्पित है।
“मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधाअपने वृंदावन को” – यह पंक्ति भक्त की उस विनम्र प्रार्थना को दर्शाती है, जहाँ वह ब्रजधाम में मोर बनकर भी राधा-कृष्ण के चरणों में रहना चाहता है।

यह भजन ध्यान, जप, सुबह-शाम की पूजा, वृंदावन भक्ति, कीर्तन और मन की शांति के लिए अत्यंत उपयुक्त है। इसकी शांत धुन और प्रेमपूर्ण शब्द आत्मा को सुकून देते हैं और मन को वृंदावन की गलियों में ले जाते हैं।

Vrindavan Essence: Experience the 'Brij Ras' from the comfort of your home.

Soulful Peace: Perfect for morning meditation or evening relaxation.

snippet.title: जाने क्यों लोग मोहब्बत किया करते हैं | Mehboob Ki Mehndi | Lata Mangeshkar Songs
snippet.description:
सत्तर के दशक की सुरीली यादों और लता मंगेशकर की जादुई आवाज़ में डूबा यह गीत 'जाने क्यों लोग मोहब्बत किया करते हैं' आज भी हर दिल को छू लेता है। यह गीत न केवल एक धुन है, बल्कि प्यार और विरह की एक गहरी दास्तां है जो दशकों बाद भी उतनी ही ताज़ा लगती है।



Credits :

Song: Jane Kyon Log Mohabbat Kiya
Album: Mehboob Ki Mehndi
Artist: Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Laxmikant-Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi 



Lyrics :

is zamane me, is mohabat ne
kitne dil tode, kitne ghar phunke
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai
dil ke badale darde dil liya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

tanhayi milti hai, mahafil nahi milti
rahe mahobat me kabhi manzil nahi milti
dil tut jata hai, nakam hota hai
ulfat ye logo ka yahi anjam hota hai
koi kya jane, kyu ye parawane,
kyu machalate hai, gum me jalate hai
aahe bhar bhar ke diwane jiya karate hai
aahe bhar bhar ke diwane jiya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

sawan me aankho ko, kitana rulati hai
furasat me jab dil ko kisi ki yaad aati hai
ye zindagi yu hi barabad hoti hai
har waqt hotho pe koi fariyad hoti hai
na dawao ka naam chalata hai
na duao se kam chalata hai
zahar ye phir bhi sabhi kyu piya karate hai
zahar ye phir bhi sabhi kyu piya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

mahabub se har gum manasub hota hai
din rat ulfat me tamasha khub hota hai
rato se bhi lambe ye pyar ke kise
aashiq sunate hai zafa ye yaar ke kise
bemurawat hai, bewafa hai wo,
us sitamagar ka apne dilwar ka,
naam le leke duhayi diya karate hai
naam le leke duhayi diya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

इस सदाबहार नगमे को सुनकर पुरानी यादें ताज़ा हो जाती हैं। आपको यह गीत कैसा लगता है? अपनी राय हमें कमेंट में ज़रूर बताएं। अगर आपको यह वीडियो पसंद आया हो, तो इसे लाइक करें, दोस्तों के साथ शेयर करें और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।

Tabaahi ❤️✨ — a melody that speaks straight to the heart.

Featuring Yash and Kiara Advani, this soulful track is beautifully sung and composed by Vishal Mishra. Let its heartfelt lyrics and mesmerizing melody stay with you long after the music ends. 🎶

Lyrics:
तोड़ो, सारे उसूलों को
छोड़ो, जाने दो भूलो को
तू हो बाहों में Aur  हर जगह तबाही
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही ..

Todo, Saare Usoolon Ko
Chhodo, Jaane Do Bhoolo Ko
Tu Ho Baahon Mein Aur Har Jagah Tabaahi
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

कब चली पूछ के
रूह पे, क्यूँ भला
हो कोई बंदिशें
दुनिया के दस्तूर से आज ले रिहाई
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही ..

Yeh Lahar, Yeh Hawaa
Kab Chali Poochke
Rooh Pe, Kyun Bhala
Ho Koi Bandishein
Duniya Ke Dastoor Se Aaj Le Rihaayii
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

तू मुझे छील दे सांस की आग से
हर धड़क पे दोनो हो फना राख से
हर गलत सही-रेत पे लिखी गवाही
तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही तबाही

Tu Mujhe Chheel De, Saans Ki Aag Se
Har Dhadak Pe Dono Ho Fana Raakh Se
Har Galat Sahi- Ret Pe Likhi Gawaahi
Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi Tabaahi ..

snippet.title: Baap Vithuraya l Rinku Rajguru l Ajay Gogawale l Padmanabh Gaikwad l Vitthal Song l बाप विठूराया

🙏 @saregamamarathi सादर करत आहे "Baap Vithuraya", Ajay Gogavale यांच्या भावपूर्ण आवाजात, Padmanabh Gaikwad यांच्या सुरेल संगीताने आणि Rinku Rajguru यांच्या प्रभावी अभिनयाने साकारलेले एक हृदयस्पर्शी विठ्ठलभक्ती गीत. आषाढी वारीचा भक्तिभाव, विठ्ठलावरील श्रद्धा आणि भक्त-भगवंत यांच्यातील अतूट नात्याचा सुंदर अनुभव या गीतातून मिळतो.

श्वासांत विठ्ठल, देहात विठ्ठल

डोळ्यांत विठ्ठल, आशेत विठ्ठल
हृदयात विठ्ठल, ओसंडला

मेघांत विठ्ठल, भूमीत विठ्ठल
जीवांत विठ्ठल, बा सावळा 

बोलतो विठ्ठल, पाहतो विठ्ठल

तोच माय, तोच बाप विठुराया, पंढरीचा 

आलो भेटीला सख्या श्रीरंगा, रे विठ्ठला

रूप पाहतां लोचनी,
सुख जाले वो साजणी
तो हा विठ्ठल बरवा,
तो हा माधव बरवा

डोईवरी ती तुळस

पाहता हर्ष डोळ्यांतूनी दाटला

सांगतो विठ्ठल, ऐकतो विठ्ठल
हा देखणा सोहळा 

तोच माय तोच बाप विठुराया पंढरीचा 
आलो भेटीला सख्या श्रीरंगा रे विठ्ठला

रूप पाहतां लोचनी,
सुख जाले वो साजणी
तो हा विठ्ठल बरवा
तो हा माधव बरवा

Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai,

Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya.

Tere Maathe Aaaaa….Tere Maathe Ke Kumkum Ko

Teri Baali Ki Chhunchhun Ko
Main Dil Se Lagaa Ke Jhoomoonga…

Tere Jude Ke Phoolon Ko, 
Main Apne Shirt Mein Pehnoonga.

Bas Mere Liye Tu Maalpue Kabhi Kabhi Bana Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Ratiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Din Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya. 

Antara 2-
Tu Maange Sardi Mein Amiya, 
Jo Maange Garmi Mein Mungphaliyaan, 
Tu Baarish Mein Agar Keh De,
Ja Mere Liye Tu Dhoop Khila.

Toh Main Sooraj……. Toh Main Sooraj Ko Jhatak Doonga, 
Toh Main Saawan Ko Gatak Loonga,
Toh Saare Taaron Sang Chanda
Main Teri Goad Mein Rakh Doonga-

Bas Mere Liye Tu Khil Ke Kabhi Muskuraa Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Sadiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Pal Mera Ho Gaya.

snippet.description:
🙏🐘 ఆషాఢం బుధవారం గణపతి అష్టకం LIVE 🐘🙏
ఈ గణపతి అష్టకం భక్తితో వింటే సకల విఘ్నాలు తొలగిపోతాయి

"ఏకదంతం మహాకాయం తప్తకాంచనసన్నిభమ్
లంబోదరం విశాలాక్షం వందేహం గణనాయకమ్" 

భక్తితో గణపతి అష్టకాన్ని వింటే సకల విఘ్నాలు తొలగిపోతాయని పెద్దల నమ్మకం.

ହେ ଜଗତର ନାଥ, ମୋ କଳା ସାଆନ୍ତ! ଦୀର୍ଘ ବର୍ଷକର ପ୍ରତୀକ୍ଷା ଆଜି ଶେଷ ହୋଇଛି। ଯେଉଁ ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ଦିନରାତି ଆଖିରୁ ଲୁହ ଗଡ଼ାଉଥିଲା, ସେହି ଦୀନବାନ୍ଧବ ଆଜି ରଥାରୂଢ଼ ହୋଇ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଆସିଛନ୍ତି। ଜାତି, ଧର୍ମ, ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ନିଜର ଦୁଇ ବାହୁ ପ୍ରସାରି କୋଳେଇ ନେବାକୁ ମୋ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବିରାଜମାନ କରିଛନ୍ତି। ସେହି ଅଲୌକିକ, ମହିମାମୟ ଆଉ ଭକ୍ତିରସରେ ଜୁଡୁବୁଡୁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଦେଖି ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ନିଜ ସାଥୀ ବନ୍ଧୁକୁ ଆକୁଳ ହୋଇ ଡାକୁଛି— "ଆରେ ଦେଖ୍, ଦେଖ୍... ଆମ ଦୁଃଖସୁଖର ସାଥୀ, ଆମ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବସିଛି!" ଏହି ଦିବ୍ୟ ଭାବକୁ ଅତି ମନୋରମ ଢଙ୍ଗରେ ବଖାଣୁଛି ରଥଯାତ୍ରାର ଏହି ଚମତ୍କାର ଆଉ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ— "ରଥରେ ବସିଛି କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଦେଖେ ତାକୁ"।

ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଗର୍ବ, ପ୍ରିୟ କଣ୍ଠଶିଳ୍ପୀ ନମିତା ଅଗ୍ରୱାଲଙ୍କ କଣ୍ଠରେ ଏହି ରଥଯାତ୍ରା ସ୍ପେଶାଲ ଭଜନଟି ଶୁଣିଲେ ଗରୁଡ଼ ପରି ମନ ଧାଇଁଯିବ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଆଉ ଛାତି ଭିତରୁ ଶୁଭିବ ହରିବୋଲ, ହୁଳହୁଳିର ମହାନାଦ।
